title: A block continued after a forced cut ended at the first PEM or .creds end marker of either kind, so a foreign end marker released the rest of the block
resolution: A cut block keeps its open begin markers as a sealed context, so it ends only at its own kind's end marker; redactor and PostgreSQL restart tests of both directions fail before the fix.

title: The final release at a turn's end used redactSecrets, which keeps an interrupted secret such as a JWT prefix, so the prefix became stored and served output
resolution: The final release records an open block and an interrupted JWT, issued secret, seed, or URL user information as one marker; tests at every cut and the PostgreSQL recovery test fail before the fix.

title: After an upgrade the new output route serves entries that the earlier per-chunk redaction stored, in which halves of a split secret may stand as plaintext
resolution: Coordinator decision (a), 2026-10-29: 13a and 13b are not ancestors of origin/main (91b9ac6b), so no release holds per-chunk output; design.md and g3-plan row 13 guard that a promotion carries 13d with them.

title: The delta leaves the requirement Event payloads and session text redacting a generation's output as one text, while section 7 now holds a turn's output
resolution: A MODIFIED delta of Event payloads and session text redacts a turn's output as one text, keeping its scenarios; the archive in a scratch copy validates strictly.

title: No PostgreSQL test kept a word or block continuation across a commit and restart, or crashed the transaction of the final release
resolution: PostgreSQL restart tests of the run and block continuations and crash tests of a releasing generation end; mutants losing the continuation or splitting the release transaction fail them.

title: The scenario Secret split across chunks asks equality with the whole text's redaction without the bound's condition, which the forced cut breaks on purpose
resolution: The scenario and its requirement hold the equality only while no held part passes the bound and the turn does not end inside a block or a cut secret.

title: The verification limit says recordTurnAcceptanceUnknown keeps its turn running with a tail, while it takes a queued turn that holds no tail
resolution: The limit now states that recordTurnAcceptanceUnknown takes a queued turn, which holds no tail.

title: The design names the extracted turn check checkOutput, while the code names it checkOutputTurn

At a turn's end or on recovery, interrupted URL user information without a colon, such as a trailing https://ghp_token cut before its @, was released verbatim although the design redacts URL user information before its @
resolution: At a turn's end and on recovery, a trailing run after a URL's :// without a slash, query, fragment, or at sign becomes one marker after the scheme, also without a colon; a trailing bare host is over-redacted, as the design and limitations state. Four redactor tests fail before the fix.

title: The held tail's version restarted at 1 after each clear, so a turn that held, released, and held again sealed two tails under the same authenticated data, against the design's next version per write
resolution: A tail emptied within its turn keeps its row and seals an empty tail under the next version, so versions only grow until the turn's end deletes the row; two PostgreSQL tests fail before the fix.

title: The verification named the route's pass 2 reviewer claude-opus-5-5#xhigh, which governance v9 replaced with claude-fable-5-1 at medium, and still said pass 2 was not started
resolution: The verification names the pass 2 reviewer that ran, claude claude-fable-5-1 at medium under governance v9, states that the route's earlier recommendation was superseded, and records pass 2 and the owed pass 3.

title: When a cut .creds block's context and its partial marker overflowed the bound, the partial begin of a nested PEM key was dropped, so the next .creds end marker released the key's body
resolution: An overflowing partial marker is kept as context: in a .creds block it counts as a key's begin, in a key it is dropped. The four-chunk case, enumerated two- and three-chunk splits of nested blocks at a small bound, and a PostgreSQL restart test fail before the fix.

title: The final release kept a trailing run that is a short prefix of a secret shape, such as e, ey, tko, or SO, and a test required SO to stay
resolution: At the final release a trailing non-empty prefix of a shape head (eyJ, tkop, tken, tkwk, SO, SA, SU) becomes one marker; design decision 1 states the rule. The exact turn-end test of every cut, the head test, and the boundary test fail before the fix.

title: The verification recorded passes 1 and 2 without their make review invocations and the tools' confirmations of model and effort
resolution: Section Independent review gives each pass's make review invocation, prompt, log, and the tool's confirmation lines, cited outside the tree.

title: Two test comments gave 196,608 bytes for an entry of '€'.repeat(65_535) plus a newline, which holds 196,606 bytes
resolution: Both comments state 196,606 bytes, checked with node; 54 entries still pass the window.
